notes.content:
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list][*]Added a new Video Mode setting in the Options to adjust the performance tradeoff of videos in order to alleviate slowdowns and crashes on certain systems.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the game to freeze if certain operations occurred during video playback.
[*]Fixed some typos in the text.
[*]Various minor fixes and adjustments.[/list]
